turns.assessment: The step is confined to och7 at its S07 receiver: the S03→S07 amplifiers and the S07 incoming OCM saw no optical change, while trx.och7.z saw matching received-power and estimated-OSNR drops. This localizes the loss after the incoming OCM, most consistently to channel-specific attenuation in the S07 drop WSS. Receiver degradation is less likely because pre-FEC BER did not change and the primary observation is an actual power reduction.

proposals.rationale: A channel-specific S07 WSS attenuation drift can reduce och7 power between the incoming OCM and trx.och7.z, explaining why the receiver changed while the span amplifiers and S07 line-side OCM remained stable.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: A receiver-local defect could distort its power and estimated-OSNR reporting without upstream changes, but the unchanged pre-FEC BER provides little evidence for the documented receiver penalty.
